messages:
Ravi Singh: Hey y'all! I'm Ravi (he/him) 11 joined today on Eng-SRE. Based in Toronto (EST). Big fan of strong chai, terrible puns, and table tennis. Looking forward to meeting people and learning the ropes. :wave: :tea:
Maya: Welcome Ravi!! :tada: Chai + table tennis sounds like a perfect combo. Are you in-office usually?
Ravi Singh: Hybrid for now 1 usually in the Toronto hub Wed/Thu. Happy to host a quick after-work ping/pong + chai on a Thursday if folks are around.
Omar: Love this. Count me in for ping pong. Also very keen on chai recipe swap. :raised_hands:
Zoe: Welcome! Im in NYC but sometimes come up to TO. :table_tennis: :coffee:
Maya: Quick poll react with :house: if you prefer hub in-person, :globe_with_meridians: for a hybrid event, :coffee: if you just want a virtual chai chat.
Maya: :globe_with_meridians:
Omar: :house:
Zoe: :coffee:
Lina: :globe_with_meridians:
Ravi Singh: Looks like hybrid is winning. How about Thu Apr 8, 18:00 ET 130 min: 30m casual ping/pong in the hub + virtual chai hang for remote folks? I'll bring a thermos of my grandma's masala mix. :grin:
Lina: that works for me. if people are remote, can we put a laptop on the corner table so they can watch the chaos?
Omar: perfect. also down to rotate games (foosball next time?)
calendar-bot: Event created: "Chai & Ping 1 Ravi's Intro"  Thu Apr 8 18:00 ET  30 minutes  Invites sent to participants.
Maya: Got the invite, thanks! See you then :thumbsup:
Ravi Singh: Thanks everyone for the warm welcome  really excited to be here. I'll post the event link and a tiny RSVP form for hub vs remote so I can bring enough cups :cup_with_straw:
